note: Bands are heuristic tertiles on the 1-6 scale (no neutral midpoint, forced-choice), proportionally rescaled from the original 1-5 convention. Fine for a reflective tool; revisit once you have cohort data to set real thresholds.

bands.label: Reserved
bands.description: You draw energy from solitude or small groups. You tend to observe before engaging, and you don't need to be the centre of attention.

bands.label: Situationally social
bands.description: You're comfortable in company but don't need it constantly; your energy shifts with context and mood.

bands.label: Outgoing
bands.description: You're energised by people and activity. You start conversations easily and are comfortable being noticed.

bands.label: Direct
bands.description: You put honesty and your own judgement ahead of smoothing things over, and you're comfortable with friction if it serves the truth.

bands.label: Selectively warm
bands.description: You're cooperative with people who've earned your trust, and more guarded with those who haven't.

bands.label: Warm
bands.description: You're quick to sympathise with and accommodate others, and you tend to put relationships and harmony first.

bands.label: Spontaneous
bands.description: You prefer flexibility to fixed plans, and you can let structure slide when something more interesting comes up.

bands.label: Adaptive planner
bands.description: You're organised when it matters and relaxed about the rest.

bands.label: Structured
bands.description: You're reliable, detail-oriented and driven to follow through; loose ends bother you.

bands.label: Steady
bands.description: You're generally even-keeled; stress doesn't easily throw off your mood or focus.

bands.label: Responsive
bands.description: You feel things fairly intensely, but you recover with some space or time.

bands.label: Sensitive
bands.description: You feel emotional shifts strongly and quickly, and deliberate regulation practices help you.

bands.label: Practical
bands.description: You prefer the concrete and proven to the abstract or experimental, and you value what's tested and useful.

bands.label: Curious within limits
bands.description: You're open to new ideas selectively, especially when they connect to interests you already have.

bands.label: Imaginative
bands.description: You're drawn to ideas, patterns and novelty, and you enjoy abstract or unconventional thinking.
